cases.name: Victoria Jo “Vikki” Gamble
cases.about:
Her Go Fund Me said, "Victoria was an extremely proud mom of her two boys. She loved her boys with all her heart and soul, and they were the center of her world. She was also a dear and loving friend to many people.

She always had a bubbly attitude and had far too much trust in people. She loved socializing and meeting new people. She loved life so much that even when things were not on her side, she still tried to be positive. She looked forward to her time with her boys, and when she was off duty as a parent, she spent time with her friends.

On August 12th, she trusted the wrong person. She met a man after hearing he was from her hometown. He took advantage of her interest and manipulated her into trusting him, using their hometown connection as a way to do so. As the night was ending, she grew to trust this man who offered to drive her home and she accepted.

Victoria always saw the good in everyone, and being from the same hometown, that was enough for her to trust him and the situation. She didn't know he just got out on bail on 8/3/24 after being charged on 8/1/24 for a violent crime of domestic violence/strangulation."

Her obituary said, "She grew up in Hibbing, MN and graduated from Hibbing High School in 2003.

Victoria currently worked as a Rehab Billing Specialist at Champion Rehab at County Manor in Sartell, MN. She was very proud of her job and loved the team she worked with.

Vikki was very social and loved being around people and her friends, but most of all loved spending time with her two boys, Preston and Charlie. She always knew how to make you feel like you were her best friend. Vikki also enjoyed spending time fishing and golfing."
